purpose: Make one physical workforce budget explicit across existing and commercial/town handling tasks,without assuming that unspent cereal allowance is available logistics labor. This is a finite manufactured constraint checker,not empirical task-rate calibration or an Earth staffing assignment.
api: Require unique physical workforce IDs, explicit finite nonnegative annual and twelve-bin work capacities, complete baseline monthly work plus consistent baseline annual use, and an explicit boolean complete-schedule declaration. Require uniquely named additional tasks, each assigned once to a physical workforce, original monthly bin, role label and finite nonnegative supplied hours. Group additional tasks once by physical workforce/month and check BOTH annual and monthly constraints at the existing work scale1e-8*max(1,capacity). Reaping already included in listed baseline annual work must not be charged again as another baseline. Reject duplicate IDs,unknown/missing timing,incomplete schedule,invalid mapping/values,baseline annual/monthly inconsistency and any budget exceedance. Do not pool unused time between different workforces or issue separate capacity perrole. Return a budget certificate only for the supplied manufactured contract;do not infer source affiliation,physical travel,task hours per grain,staff capacity or empirical qualification.

Unit tests cover duplicate workforce/task IDs and invalid inputs as well. No old component_work,food/stock,graph,Dijkstra,weather,crop or population calls. No Earthcase/replay or newly assignedstaff,logistics rate,demographic update,fit oratlas/default adoption.
